script.base: Most likely flow: Baltimore leads by halftime at home as a 12.5-point favorite (implied 29.5). Lamar Jackson keeps the offense on schedule (Week 1 he added 6 rushes for 70 yards) and Derrick Henry, who had 18 carries, takes the late clock-kill carries once the lead is safe. Pace leans run after the lead. Cleveland, implied 17 with Joe Flacco, falls behind and throws more, but the low team total says the Browns move the ball without stacking points. Blowout flag: if it is 17-plus by the fourth, Henry and Zay Flowers lose late snaps. Every leg below is built for this control script.
script.flip1: Cleveland hangs around. Flacco hits the Week-1 target cluster — Harold Fannin Jr. 9 targets/63 yards/65 air, Cedric Tillman 8/52/67 air, Jerry Jeudy 8/66/97 air, Dylan Sampson 8 targets/64 yards on -25 air yards — against a Ravens defense that just allowed 7 passes of 20+ and 11.11 YPA in the middle (9 attempts) and 9.44 YPA left (18 attempts).
